title: Swamp Alligator at Dusk
description: A weathered wooden rowboat floats among lily pads in a dark swamp waterway. An alligator swims near the center while gnarled cypress trees draped in Spanish moss frame the scene under a purple and yellow twilight sky.
prompt: A moody swamp scene at twilight with a weathered green and brown wooden rowboat floating among dense lily pads in dark water. A realistic alligator swims in the middle of the channel. Large ancient cypress trees with heavy Spanish moss and some white flowers on the trunks line both sides of the waterway. Purple and yellow sky visible through the trees, atmospheric and slightly eerie bayou environment, detailed realistic painting style
